content:
{
  "root_cause": "Escape key hides the dropdown menu but does not return focus to the toggle button, leaving focus on the menu item or elsewhere.",
  "repair_strategy": "Modify the dropdown's dataApiKeydownHandler to focus the toggle button after hiding the menu when Escape is pressed.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "js/src/dropdown.js",
      "sha256": "fc69a61b69ae1fa2c2bb923fdc393dd2742925e8af996376df5f98e38f8d810e",
      "before": "    if (isEscapeEvent) {\n      instance.hide()\n      return\n    }",
      "after": "    if (isEscapeEvent) {\n      instance.hide()\n      getToggleButton.focus()\n      return\n    }"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Pressing Escape will close the invoice actions menu and move focus back to the 'Invoice actions' toggle button, meeting keyboard accessibility expectations.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "If the toggle button becomes detached or hidden while the menu is open, focusing it could fail or cause unexpected behavior.",
    "Focusing the toggle after hide may interfere with other scripts that also attempt to manage focus during hide.",
    "Risk of focusing a disabled toggle (though the code path already checks isDisabled on the keydown target)."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "After opening the menu with ArrowDown, pressing Escape must result in aria-expanded='false' on the toggle and focus returning to the toggle.",
    "Escape should not alter focus when the menu is not open.",
    "ArrowUp and ArrowDown navigation within the menu must continue to work as before.",
    "Closing the menu via click outside or Esc from other contexts should not inadvertently shift focus when inappropriate."
  ]
}
